about: Twelve original illustrative security alerts for the LangGraph triage mini project; six escalate and six close.

alerts.alert: EDR detected ransomware encrypting files on the accounting workstation.
alerts.note: Active file encryption could disrupt operations and requires immediate containment.

alerts.alert: Firewall blocked an RCE exploit attempt against the public web server.
alerts.note: An attempted exploit against an internet-facing system needs investigation even if blocked.

alerts.alert: Cloud audit log shows a new access key created for a dormant service account at 02:18.
alerts.note: Unexpected credential creation on an unused account may indicate unauthorized access.

alerts.alert: Windows event log shows an admin account added to the Domain Admins group outside the change window.
alerts.note: Unapproved privileged group membership can give an attacker broad access.

alerts.alert: Network sensor recorded a workstation sending 9 GB to an unfamiliar external address overnight.
alerts.note: Unusual large outbound traffic could indicate data theft despite no obvious keyword.

alerts.alert: EDR flagged credential dumping behavior from an unsigned process on a payroll laptop.
alerts.note: Attempts to access stored credentials can enable account compromise.

alerts.alert: Approved ransomware simulation ran on an isolated training VM during a scheduled exercise.
alerts.note: This was an authorized test in an isolated environment, not an actual infection.

alerts.alert: Windows log recorded one mistyped password followed by a successful employee sign-in.
alerts.note: A single corrected login mistake is common routine activity.

alerts.alert: Cloud audit log recorded the nightly backup service listing storage buckets on schedule.
alerts.note: The known backup identity performed its expected scheduled operation.

alerts.alert: IDS recorded a critical scan signature from the company vulnerability scanner during its approved window.
alerts.note: The scan was authorized and came from the organization’s own scanner.

alerts.alert: EDR reported that an antivirus signature update completed on a receptionist laptop.
alerts.note: A successful security definition update is normal maintenance.

alerts.alert: Windows event log recorded an approved administrator installing monthly patches on the test server.
alerts.note: The activity matches an approved maintenance task.
